annotations.title: Match a resume to a job

description: Use this when the user has a resume and a job posting and asks how well they match, what keywords are missing, or whether to apply. For rewrites, use tailor_resume instead. Returns the Studio's resumeQuality as the headline, jobFit separately, and keywordCoverage (also coverage for compatibility). Never average them. Lists matched and missing terms, their posting sentences, match types, weights and required/preferred coverage. Quality uses the versioned judge with rules fallback; keyword coverage uses fixed rules. Posting 120–20,000 characters. Rules version 2026-11-11.1.

job_description.description: The full job posting as plain text, including its requirements (120–20,000 characters). For a link, call fetch_job_post first.

resume_text.description: The whole resume as plain text, one heading, role or bullet per line.

name: match_job
